probeMethod: New Email Filter → select Source → wait for Operation enabled → read options → Cancel (nothing saved)

replay.mechanism: Edit → tick checkbox Replay Job → Save
replay.label: Replay Job

notes: Source / Operation labels are human-readable (not TEXTBODY / Startswith API tokens).
Earlier HasAttachments-only reading for TEXTBODY was a false positive: Operation picklist had not refreshed after Source change.
HTML Body and Message Id are NOT on Email Filter Source — scenarios skip with reason.
Email Send Date / Email Received Date scenarios stay removed from the suite (parent request).
Field Parser uses 'Attached File Names' (not 'Attachment File Names') for attachment filename parsing.
